name: Josh Colbert
title: DPT, Cert. MDT
bio: Dr. Colbert was born and raised in Port St. Joe, Florida before moving to Nashville to attend Belmont University. While at Belmont he earned a Bachelor of Science in Biology. After graduating with his undergraduate degree in 1998, Josh enrolled in the physical therapy program at Belmont where he graduated with a Doctorate in Physical Therapy in 2001.

Since completing PT school Dr. Colbert has practiced exclusively in the field of outpatient orthopedic physical therapy. In addition to his clinical practice, he has completed yearly post-graduate training, the highlight being in 2011 when he was awarded a certification in Mechanical Diagnosis and Therapy from the prestigious McKenzie Institute of New Zealand

name: Kevin Robinson
title: MPT, OCS, DSc
bio: Dr. Robinson graduated from the East Carolina University physical therapy program in 1986. His clinical experience is in orthopedics and sports medicine, and he has worked in outpatient clinics serving both high school and college athletes. Kevin was the first certified orthopedic physical therapy specialist in middle Tennessee. He currently teaches courses in orthopedics and kinesiology at Belmont University and is the director of the physical therapy school’s motion analysis lab.

In addition to his responsibilities at Belmont, Dr. Robinson continues to maintain an active clinic schedule. Prior to joining Belmont, Kevin was a faculty member at Tennessee State University and at East Carolina University and was an adjunct faculty with the University of Kentucky. His research interests include motion analysis, orthopedic assessment, and orthopedic intervention.

name: Rachel Morton
title: PT, DPT
bio: Rachel Morton, DPT is a physical therapist in Franklin, TN, practicing since 2008. She received her undergraduate degree from Abilene Christian University and a Doctor of Physical Therapy from Belmont University. Rachel specializes in chronic and complex pain, affecting all areas of the body. Rachel also specializes in neurological physical therapy, balance training, and custom orthotics.

Rachel is certified in dry needling and visceral mobilization and is Spanish-speaking. She is trained in Bioness, wheelchair evaluations, custom orthotics, PONS, and ReWalk. Rachel loves to help her patients find the joy and ease in movement and return them to their favorite activities. In her free time she loves to be out on the court playing tennis, skiing, or reading and listening to any podcast that comes her way!

name: Spence Tomlinson
title: PT, DPT
bio: Dr. Spence Tomlinson is a middle Tennessee native who has been practicing Orthopedic physical therapy for over 11 years. He attended Belmont University in Nashville for both undergraduate and his doctorate degrees. He has been eclectically trained in manual therapy, McKenzie method, and multiple fitness and exercise based methodologies.

His philosophy of treatment is whole patient focused, addressing patient’s source of pain and dysfunction as well as addressing health and lifestyle factors of sleep, diet, stress, and exercise/fitness. He loves treating at the 1:1 individual level, giving each patient an hour of specific and individualized care. He has specific passions and expertise in spinal pain and treatment, headache and TMJ treatment, and shoulder rehabilitation.

Additionally, he enjoys treating the ball/court sport and fitness athlete alike, focusing on return to sports fully and completely. In his personal life, Dr. Tomlinson is married to his wife Claire for 11 years, and has 3 kids. He has 3 dogs and is an avid golfer. He has been a member of CrossFit Nolensville for 2 years and has a true passion for health and fitness.
He also attends Conduit Church in Franklin, TN and is actively involved there as well.

name: Ann Marie Wilson
title: PT, DPT
bio: Dr. Ann Marie Wilson is a passionate and energetic orthopedic physical therapist hailing from the beaches of Wilmington, NC. Ann Marie relocated to Middle Tennessee after earning her Doctorate in Physical Therapy at Elon University. Prior to that, her academic career saw her earn a Bachelors of Science degree in Exercise Science and a Bachelor of Arts degree in Public Health with focus in Biological Aspects of Health and Illness.

After 6 years of continued training with McKenzie, Maitland manual therapy and Pain Neuroscience courses, her main focus is on personalized care treating the full individual through 1-on-1 care. Ann Marie grew up in a magical performance family and took that passion to focus on performing arts PT. Growing up the daughter of retired magicians, you could find her on the stage dancing, singing and acting or on the field/court playing three sports.

This molded her passion for fitness to care for those in the athletic space both on the field, on the stage and in the gym. Ann Marie is also an Orangetheory Fitness coach who thrives in progressing independence and conquering goals creating a healthier and happier community. In her personal life, Dr. Wilson is regularly traveling the world, attending musicals or concerts with her husband of 8 years, Andrew.

She can also be found running with her dog, Riley, or watching movies with her 3 cats. She has a passion for group fitness as a member of OTF for 6 years and a coach for 2 years. Let’s get better together!

name: Casee Adams
title: PT, DPT
bio: Casee Adams PT, DPT is a native of Watson, Louisiana. She graduated with her Bachelor Degree in Exercise Science from Univeristy of Louisiana Monroe in 2014. She went on to graduate with her Doctorate of Physical Therapy from University of St. Augustine in 2017. Casee then moved to Nashville in fall of 2017 and has been working in outpatient orthopedics since then.

She joined the Performance team in 2022. She is certified in dry needling, has taken all MDT Courses from McKenzie Institute, as well as many other continuing education courses to further her knowledge and ability to best treat her patients. When she isn’t working, Casee enjoys playing in Nashville adult softball leagues, hiking, watching the Alabama Crimson Tide and New Orleans Saints, reading a good book, and spending time with friends.

name: Craig Parker
title: DPT
bio: Dr. Parker completed his graduate studies at Belmont University in Nashville, TN, and has since dedicated his professional efforts as a full-time physical therapist in outpatient orthopedics in addition to parallel roles in clinical research, higher education, and coaching youth soccer. His research to date has focused predominantly on exploring innovative treatment approaches to mitigate injury risk and optimize human performance using a unique constellation of biomechanical outcome measures and training techniques developed in concert with Belmont’s Motion Analysis Laboratory.

He currently teaches Biomechanics & Biomechanical Assessment at TNU’s Master of Exercise Science program as well as Exercise Physiology to undergraduates at the same university. He holds certifications in Trigger Point Dry Needling (TrDN) and Blood Flow Restriction (BFR) Training and is the founder and principal at the Neuromuscular Training Academy where he serves developing athletes in the community.

name: Jackson Boggs
title: PT, DPT, CSCS
bio: Jackson Boggs is a licensed Doctor of Physical Therapy (DPT) and Certified Strength and Conditioning Specialist (CSCS) dedicated to helping individuals achieve their optimal level of function and performance. Born and raised in Lexington, KY, Jackson attended the University of Kentucky, where he earned both his Doctorate in Physical Therapy and a Bachelor’s in Exercise Science.
In his free time, Jackson enjoys staying active, working on improving his golf game, and attending concerts.

name: Hunter Boyd
title: DPT
bio: Dr. Boyd is a native of Nashville. He attended Freed-Hardeman University in Henderson, Tennessee where he received a Bachelor of Science in Biology in 2019. Hunter went on to earn his Doctorate in Physical Therapy from Harding University in Searcy, Arkansas in 2024. Dr. Boyd is excited to be serving in his hometown community and enjoys working with patients amongst all stages of the lifespan.

Hunter has a variety of professional interests and intends to pursue advanced certifications. In his free time, Hunter loves playing golf, hiking, reading, and spending time with his local church family.

name: Nicholas Horne
title: DPT
bio: I am from Bristol, TN and did my undergraduate studies at East Tennessee State University in Johnson City getting my bachelor’s degree in Exercise Science. Before going to physical therapy school at Rocky Mountain University of Health Professions for my DPT degree, I was a licensed massage therapist. I grew up playing sports but narrowed my focus to track and field/cross country which I competed for ETSU and have done marathons and ultramarathons in states across the country.
Now, I reside in Franklin, TN where I like to stay active, spend time with my partner, and am beginning to learn how to play and create music.

name: Amanda Diveley
title: PTA
bio: With 16 years of diverse experience as a Physical Therapist Assistant, I have worked with a wide range of patients—from those in acute inpatient settings to elite athletes and everyone in between. I enjoy teaching mobility and recovery in all types of athletes and fall risk training in older adults. Along with my clinical expertise, I’ve also serve as practice manager, where I’ve honed my skills in administration, team leadership, and operational efficiency.
I am a versatile and dedicated professional, committed to enhancing both patient outcomes and practice success.

name: Abigail King
title: M.S., CCC-SLP
bio: Abigail King, M. S., CCC-SLP, is a Speech-Language Pathologist and graduate of Harding University and The University of Tennessee Health Science Center. Graduate school is where she discovered her passion for working with adult patients of varying diagnoses including dysphagia, aphasia, voice, and cognitive-communication disorders.

She is certified in Lee Silverman Voice Therapy LOUD (LSVT LOUD) to aid patients with Parkinson’s disease and is certified in McNeill Dysphagia Therapy Program (MDTP) to treat patients with various swallowing disorders, including individuals with head and neck cancer. She completed her externship in the inpatient setting at UVA Health and her clinical fellowship at Carilion outpatient clinic in Virginia.
She is excited to be back home closer to friends and family. In her free time, you can find Abigail hiking, playing soccer or board games, and eating ice cream.

name: Hayley Fuller
title: OTD, OTR/L
bio: Dr. Hayley Fuller, OTD, OTR/L, earned her Doctorate in Occupational Therapy from Belmont University and is passionate about helping individuals improve their quality of life through pelvic health rehabilitation. During her doctoral training, she completed a specialized pelvic floor clinical rotation at the prestigious Spear Physical Therapy in New York City, where she worked with a diverse population of patients across the lifespan.

Hayley has experience treating a wide range of pelvic health conditions, including pregnancy and postpartum-related concerns, urinary incontinence, pelvic pain, pain with intercourse, sacroiliac joint dysfunction, pubic symphysis pain, low back pain, diastasis recti, and C-section scar dysfunction. She is dedicated to providing compassionate, individualized care and empowering her patients through education and evidence-based treatment strategies.
Hayley is excited to establish and grow the pelvic floor therapy program at Performance Therapy Institute and looks forward to helping patients return to the activities that matter most to them.

name: Katherine Rauch
title: OTD, OTR/L, CPAM, CLT-LANA
bio: Katherine is an Iowa native who has called Tennessee home since 2020. She earned her Bachelors of Science degree from Iowa State University and her Doctorate of Occupational Therapy from Belmont University. She is a Certified Lymphedema Therapy through the Norton Academy of Lymphatic Studies as well as the Lymphology Association of North America.

Her clinical interests include cancer rehabilitation, lymphedema, lipedema, progressive neurological disorders, and various neurological conditions. When she isn’t working Katherine enjoys going to concerts, watching the Iowa State Cyclones, Chicago Bears, and Chicago Cubs. She can also be found playing with her two adorable dogs, Biscuit and Tater.

name: Donni Chandler
bio: Donni is a native Floridian who has called Nashville her home for 4 years and has worked as an Office Manager with Performance Therapy Institute for the past 2 years. Donni coordinates administration and insurance benefit support in the Nashville clinic. She received a BA in Business Administration with a minor in Music Education from the University of South Florida and loves how Nashville highlights her love of medicine and music.

Donni developed a strong sense of appreciation for physical therapy after her mother experienced acute trauma in 2012 resulting in multiple joint replacements; giving her a deep understanding of how physical therapy is essential to improve the quality of life of those recovering from surgery and/or traumatic events. Donni enjoys reading, watching movies and being outdoors, all of which are enjoyed even more when accompanied by her husband and son.

name: Ethan Newman
bio: Ethan moved to Nashville with his partner from Pennsylvania in 2019. He earned a degree in Exercise Science from West Chester University and has over 6 years of experience in outpatient healthcare. Over the past year he has worked as an office manager at Performance Therapy Institute, coordinating patient care for the Nashville office.
Outside of work he enjoys bouldering at Climb Nashville, running, playing chess, reading, cooking, and brewing outstanding coffee.

name: Kelly Cashman
bio: Kelly is an outgoing, passionate individual who uses her strong organizational skills and clear communication to help patients navigate the complex health care system. After earning her bachelor’s degree in creative writing from Purchase College in 2021, Kelly relocated from New York to Nashville. She has spent the last five years working in reception and administrative roles to ensure things run smoothly and efficiently behind the scenes so patients can focus on their treatment.

Outside of work, Kelly values time with family and friends. She enjoys attending concerts, plays, and game nights. She also loves quiet nights at home spent cooking, baking, reading, and relaxing with her cat, Buttercup.

name: Lauren McConnell
bio: Attended Tennessee Technological University and graduated with a Bachelor’s degree in Human Ecology in 2012. Transitioned from working in Education to Healthcare in 2019. Joined the Performance Therapy Institute team in 2019 as the Officer Manager for the Franklin location for 4+ years and now serving as the Billing Specialist.
